 ‘Let Them Play Without Responsibility’ –Vinicius Steps Up To Protect Endrick, Estevao
 By Austin Akhilomen November 17, 2026 No Comments 1 Min Read 
 Real Madrid star Vinicius Junior has stepped up to protect Brazil’s rising talents from criticism, declaring that the Selecao’s senior stars must absorb the pressure so younger players can thrive.
 Despite conceding that he has struggled to hit top gear since Brazil’s disappointing World Cup campaign, the 26-year-old Real Madrid star wants teenagers Endrick and Estevao to express themselves freely during international duty in Singapore.
